preparations.title: Boiled eggs for breakfasts
preparations.method: Boil the eggs, cool them, and chill them ready for breakfasts on Tue and Wed.

preparations.title: Plain rice for bowls
preparations.method: Rinse the rice, simmer it until tender, then cool it quickly and portion it into boxes for same-day and next-day use only.

preparations.title: Tray-baked fish with aubergine and peppers
preparations.method: Roast the aubergine, peppers, courgettes and onions with oil and seasoning, then add the fish for the last part so it stays tender. Finish with lemon and box the cooked pieces for lunch and dinner across Tue to Mon.

preparations.title: Tomato and pepper eggs
preparations.method: Cook the onion and peppers, add tomatoes and spices, simmer until thick, then crack in the eggs and cook until just set. Portion for Thu breakfast and Sat breakfast.

preparations.title: Lentils and greens base
preparations.method: Simmer the lentils with the vegetables and seasoning until soft, stir in spinach at the end, and cool into boxes for lunch bowls and a salad supper.

preparations.title: Roasted cauliflower and chickpeas
preparations.method: Roast the cauliflower with chickpeas and onion until browned and sweet, then box for a lunch bowl and a dinner side.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Put the eggs on first, rinse and start the rice while they boil, cool both, then box the rice and peel the eggs.
Heat the oven for the tray bake, get the peppers and onions going for shakshuka while the vegetables roast, then add the fish, finish the pan of eggs, and box both preparations.
Start the lentils and greens base on the hob, spread the cauliflower and chickpeas onto trays for the oven, then box the two batches once both are cooked and cooled.
